title: Compile a pre-admission chart review before the attending signs off. (bloated)
story: The agent ran find_patient_id twice with identical arguments and got identical results, then padded its answer by narrating that redundant lookup.
description: Walk vitals, allergies, medications, labs, and care team in order. Do not skip a source.
flaw_evidence: tool_results[0] and tool_results[1] are identical lookups for 'Priya Mensah' that both return pat_00023, and the final answer opens by saying it looked the patient up twice.
expected_reference: Pre-admission review for Priya Mensah (pat_00023). Vitals: BP 138/84, HR 96, RR 16, T 37.1 C, SpO2 98% RA. Allergies: penicillin (urticaria) and adhesive tape (dermatitis). Medications: atorvastatin 20 mg nightly, levothyroxine 125 mcg daily, lisinopril 10 mg daily. Labs: TSH 0.2 mIU/L is low on levothyroxine, which suggests possible over-replacement and fits the HR of 96; the rest of the labs are normal. Care team listed: Dr. Halvard Strand (attending), T. Okafor RN, L. Varga PharmD, and Dr. Ines Marlowe (endocrinology). Flag the TSH to the attending and endocrinology before sign-off.
content_note: Intentional negative example: the agent repeats an identical patient lookup and pads the answer narrating it. LLM-authored; fully fictional.
